context: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION The average adult dose is 4 g a day given as one 1000 mg tablet or two 500 mg tablets after each meal and at bedtime. Children 6 to 12 years of age should receive half the adult dose; one 500 mg tablet, 4 times a day.
